paper: TrustTrade: Human-Inspired Selective Consensus Reduces Decision Uncertainty in LLM Trading Agents
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of TrustTrade's independent domain reports, hybrid selective consensus, deterministic temporal anchor, sequential trader/risk sizing, and purged short/long reflective memory; not the unreleased LLM report pipeline, human experiment, or 2026 paper decisions.

paper_source.bounded_release_search_checked_2026_09_0: The paper, Research Square copy, lab organization, and three human-study interfaces remain public, but no attributable selective-consensus, temporal-memory, decision, holding, or result pipeline is released.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Study III overview and Methods: TrustTrade overview
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Independent domain-report agents are credibility scored, selectively filtered by cross-report agreement, and combined with deterministic temporal signals before sequential trader and risk decisions.

Atomic claims form a cross-report graph using semantic and numeric similarity; support and cohesion create a consensus score that retains high-consensus evidence and down-weights conflicting evidence.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Deterministic temporal signal pipeline and Figure 7b
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Multi-horizon returns, volatility, trend consistency, forecast direction/magnitude, and confidence produce transparent BUY/SELL/HOLD recommendations and position sizes.
Trade outcomes are backfilled only after their horizons realize; short- and long-horizon return/Sharpe reflections condition later confidence, risk, and sizing decisions.

selective_consensus.atomic_claim: one bounded report score with domain, polarity, and numeric value
selective_consensus.semantic_similarity: one when two reports share nonzero polarity, zero when either is neutral, and minus one when polarities conflict
selective_consensus.numeric_similarity: exp of negative absolute report-score difference divided by 0.50
selective_consensus.support_ratio: fraction of the three reports sharing the majority nonzero polarity
selective_consensus.cohesion: mean pairwise hybrid similarity mapped to zero through one
selective_consensus.domain_evidence: mean report score multiplied by one for high consensus or 0.25 otherwise

temporal_and_memory_policy.temporal_signal: mean signed rank of 1/3/6/12-month return, high-price position, and inverse realized volatility
temporal_and_memory_policy.temporal_trend_consistency: fraction of horizon return signs matching the 12-month direction
temporal_and_memory_policy.hold_rule: carry the prior valid position; reset stale positions after a missing security month
temporal_and_memory_policy.buy_sell_rule: set signed target size from confidence, capped by the risk manager
temporal_and_memory_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the reflected position score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: multiple independent reports in four information domains
atomic normalized claims with polarity and numeric value
hybrid semantic and numeric cross-report agreement
selective retention and down-weighting of low-consensus evidence
transparent BUY, SELL, and HOLD action logic
position sizing conditional on confidence and current state
memory outcomes backfilled only after each horizon realizes
test-time reliability adaptation without common-period retuning
approximated_elements: three deterministic JKP reports per domain replace unspecified independent LLM agents
earnings surprises and attention characteristics replace unavailable causal news reports
report polarity and scalar distance replace claim embeddings and extracted numeric assertions
within-domain three-report agreement replaces the full cross-report connected-component graph
signed return ranks replace polynomial price trends and next-day forecasts
purged component RankIC history replaces LLM-generated decision reflections
continuous normalized positions replace whole-share 25/50/75/100% transactions
the common decile portfolio replaces the paper's three-stock human interface
invented_elements: the twelve report definitions and feature signs
the 0.50 semantic/numeric blend and numeric scale
the 0.60 high-consensus threshold and 0.25 low-consensus weight
the 0.60 consensus and 0.40 temporal decision blend
the monthly reflection horizons and equal weights
the 12/60-month reflection windows and equal blend
